[P1] 清华
少儿
中国名家经典原创图画书乐读本
大黑熊和小刺猬
杨永青 / 绘
清华大学出版社

[P2] 大黑熊和小刺猬

杨永青

上海市浦东新区川沙镇人，擅长版画、中国画、图书插画，早年

师从著名人物画家谢闲鸥先生，1952年—1987年历任华东青年出版社、中国青年出版社、中国少年儿童出版社美术编辑、编审。创作儿童图书220余册以及数千幅插画，20余种儿童画册以多国文字在海外出版发行。曾获全国少年儿童图书评奖美术一等奖、中国版画家协会“鲁迅奖章”、国际安徒生奖提名等诸多荣誉。获国务院妇女儿童协调委员会颁发的“有突出贡献的儿童工作者”和关心下一代工作委员会颁发的“先进个人”等称号。作品被中国美术馆等多家机构收藏。曾任文化部儿童文学艺术委员会委员、中国美术家协会儿童美术艺术委员会主任、中国版画家协会第一届理事以及其他社会兼职十余项。

作者简介

[P3] 森林里有一只大黑熊，仗着自己个头大，经常欺负小动物。“黑熊大哥，你不应该欺负弱小的动物。”小刺猬说。“一边去，小东西，把我惹了，连你也打！”大黑熊无法无天地说。

“放开我，放开我！”小兔子在半空中挣扎道。

大黑熊碰见小兔子，一把扯起小兔子的耳朵：“哈哈，这可不是耳朵，这就是两片芭蕉叶！”，

[P4] “小毛驴，快过来！”大黑熊放走小兔子，看见旁边经过的小毛驴

[P5] 驴喊道，还一把抓住了他的尾巴，“让你跑！这哪里是尾巴，这就是一根绳子！哈哈！”，
“放开我，放开我！”小毛驴使劲用后腿踢大黑熊。
“服不服？服不服？”大黑熊骑在小毛驴身上得意洋洋地问。
“竟然敢踢本大王！哼！”大黑熊一把将小毛驴推倒在地。

[P6] “不回答就是不服气！”大黑熊一屁股坐在小毛驴身上。小毛驴
疼得都流泪了。

[P7] “臭刺猬，看我不教训你！”说着，大黑熊跑到小刺猬跟前，想把小刺猬压扁。

“你个大坏蛋！”小刺猬跑过来说，“就知道欺软怕硬！有本事你去打大胖虎和小黑牛！”

“让你使坏！”小刺猬跳起来，用身上的刺扎向大黑熊的屁股。

[P8] “啊！我的屁股！疼死啦！”大黑熊张开大嘴喊叫道。
“你快下来，快下来！”大黑熊对小刺猬说道。

[P9] “不下来，不下来！”小刺猬高兴地说，“让你尝尝被教训的滋味！
大黑熊想用手把小刺猬拔下来，小刺猬一缩，大黑熊的爪子碰到了小刺猬的刺，拔不下来了。

[P10] “啊！疼死啦！我的手！我的屁股！”大黑熊朝天大叫。
大黑熊又疼又累，垂头丧气地说：“小刺猬，你饶了我吧！”

[P11] 小刺猬说：“那你得答应我，以后不许再欺负小动物们了！”“我答应你！”大黑熊回答。
小刺猬从大黑熊的屁股上跳下来：“你可要说话算话，要不然我加倍惩罚你。”“我错了，以后再也不欺负小动物了。”大黑熊再次保证。

[P12] 大黑熊揉着自己被扎的屁股一瘸一拐地回家了。他后来欺负过小动物们吗？嗯，反正我们大森林报社再也没有听说过。
full_text_en:
[P1] Tsinghua
Children's
Classic Original Picture Books by Chinese Masters
Big Black Bear and Little Hedgehog
Yang Yongqing / Illustrated
Tsinghua University Press

[P2] Big Black Bear and Little Hedgehog

Yang Yongqing

From Chuansha Town, Pudong New Area, Shanghai. Skilled in woodcut, Chinese painting, and book illustration. In his early years,

He studied under the renowned portrait painter Mr. Xie Xianou. From 1952 to 1987, he served as an art editor and reviewer at the East China Youth Publishing House, China Youth Publishing House, and China Children's Publishing House. He created over 220 children's books and thousands of illustrations, with more than 20 children's picture books published overseas in multiple languages. He has won numerous honors, including the First Prize for Art in the National Children's Book Awards, the "Lu Xun Medal" from the China Printmakers Association, and a nomination for the Hans Christian Andersen Award. He was awarded the title of "Outstanding Children's Worker" by the State Council's Women and Children's Coordination Committee and "Advanced Individual" by the Committee for Caring for the Next Generation. His works are collected by institutions such as the National Art Museum of China. He has served as a member of the Children's Literature and Art Committee of the Ministry of Culture, Chairman of the Children's Art Committee of the China Artists Association, a member of the first council of the China Printmakers Association, and held over ten other social positions.

Author Introduction

[P3] In the forest, there was a big black bear who, relying on his large size, often bullied small animals. "Big Bear Brother, you shouldn't bully weak animals," said the little hedgehog. "Get out of here, little thing! You've annoyed me, so I'll beat you too!" the big black bear said arrogantly.

"Let me go, let me go!" the little rabbit struggled in mid-air.

The big black bear met the little rabbit, grabbed the rabbit's ears, and laughed: "Haha, these aren't ears at all—they're two banana leaves!"

[P4] "Little donkey, come here quickly!" The big black bear let go of the little rabbit and saw the little donkey passing by.

[P5] The donkey shouted, and grabbed his tail, 'Let you run! This is not a tail, it's a rope! Haha!'
'Let me go, let me go!' The little donkey kicked the big black bear with all his might.
'Surrender or not? Surrender or not?' The big black bear asked proudly, riding on the little donkey.
'Dare to kick the Great King! Hmph!' The big black bear pushed the little donkey to the ground.

[P6] "Not answering means you're not giving in!" Big Black Bear sat down on the little donkey. The little donkey was in so much pain that it started crying.

[P7] "You stinky hedgehog, just wait until I teach you a lesson!" Saying that, the big black bear ran up to the little hedgehog, intending to flatten him.

"You big bully!" the little hedgehog ran over and said, "You only pick on the weak! If you're so tough, go fight Big Fat Tiger and Little Black Ox!"

"You're going to get what's coming to you!" the little hedgehog jumped up and stuck his spines into the big black bear's buttocks.

[P8] "Ah! My bottom! It hurts so much!" the big black bear shouted with his mouth wide open.
"Get down, get down quickly!" the big black bear said to the little hedgehog.

[P9] "Not coming down, not coming down!" the little hedgehog said happily, "Let you taste the flavor of being taught a lesson!"
Big Black Bear tried to pull the little hedgehog off with his hand, but the little hedgehog curled up, and Big Black Bear's claws touched the hedgehog's spines and couldn't pull him off.

[P10] "Ah! It hurts so much! My hand! My bottom!" the big black bear shouted towards the sky.
The big black bear, sore and tired, hung his head in despair and said, "Little hedgehog, please spare me!"

[P11] The little hedgehog said, "Then you must promise me, you won't bully the little animals anymore!" "I promise!" the big black bear answered.
The little hedgehog jumped down from the big black bear's bottom: "You must keep your word, or I'll punish you twice as much." "I was wrong, I'll never bully little animals again." The big black bear promised again.

[P12] The big black bear rubbed his stung bottom and limped home. Did he bully small animals later? Well, anyway, we at the Great Forest Newspaper never heard of it again.
full_summary_zh:
[P1] 本页是绘本《大黑熊和小刺猬》的封面，展示了书名、作者、出版社信息以及大黑熊和小刺猬的插图。
[P2] 本页展示了绘本《大黑熊和小刺猬》的作者杨永青的简介，包括其生平、艺术成就、荣誉及社会职务，并配有作者照片。
[P3] 本页描绘了大黑熊欺负小兔子的场景，小刺猬劝阻，大黑熊却毫不理会，并嘲笑小兔子的耳朵像芭蕉叶。
[P4] 大黑熊放走被欺负的小兔子，转而叫住路过的小毛驴，准备欺负它。
[P5] 大黑熊抓住小毛驴的尾巴，将其推倒在地并骑在身上，小毛驴奋力反抗踢踹，但被大黑熊压制。
[P6] 大黑熊将小毛驴按倒在地并坐在其身上，小毛驴因疼痛而流泪。
[P7] 大黑熊因欺负小动物而被小刺猬指责，小刺猬用身上的刺反击，扎向大黑熊的屁股。
[P8] 大黑熊被小刺猬用刺扎到屁股后，痛苦地大叫，并命令小刺猬下来。
[P9] 小刺猬骑在大黑熊的背上，大黑熊试图用手将其拔下，但小刺猬一缩，大黑熊的爪子被刺扎住，拔不下来了。
[P10] 大黑熊被小刺猬的刺扎到手和屁股后痛苦大叫，随后又疼又累地向小刺猬求饶。
[P11] 小刺猬要求大黑熊承诺不再欺负小动物，大黑熊答应后，小刺猬从其背上跳下并再次强调要说话算话，大黑熊再次保证改正错误。
[P12] 大黑熊被小刺猬的刺扎伤后，一瘸一拐地回家，故事以大森林报社未再听说他欺负小动物作结，暗示其改正了错误。
